title: Implement a Concurrent-safe Authenticator
prompt: Build a session refresh coordinator and OkHttp authentication path that handles expiry, concurrent 401s, rotation, one replay, cancellation, and terminal logout.
successCriteria: Concurrent challenges cause exactly one refresh.
Terminal failure logs out once and releases all waiters.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class RefreshCoordinator(private val session: SessionStore, private val authApi: AuthApi)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
